rationale: Both share the same recite loop and the same verse structure. B's helper returns the lowercase phrase and capitalizes it only at the start of a line, which is the natural direction. A's helper returns a capitalized 'No more bottles of beer' and then calls .lower() at almost every use site, which is roundabout and easy to get wrong. A also has two separate return branches that repeat the first-line format, while B builds the shared first line once and only branches on the second line. B is cleaner and less repetitive.
